name: marker
description: Displays an inline status, system note, bordered row, or labeled separator in a conversation.
purpose: Marks status updates, tool activity, and labeled breaks in a thread without owning the full message chrome.
bestFor: date and section breaks in a conversation
avoidFor: full chat bubbles that need avatars and timestamps

examples.name: Default
examples.code: {markerMocks.default.switched} {markerMocks.default.thinking} {markerMocks.default.compacted} {markerMocks.default.explored}

examples.name: Variants
examples.code: {markerMocks.variants.default} {markerMocks.variants.separator} {markerMocks.variants.border}
